title: Herald FAQ document
description: Schema for a Herald FAQ document. One file per surface (e.g. herald-oss.json). Sections group questions; each item carries an HTML answer rendered by the website consumer. Heather (docs author) owns the grouping; the consumer renders sections in file order and items in array order.

surface.description: Short identifier for the product surface this FAQ covers (e.g. 'herald-oss', 'herald-pro', 'tesseraseal').

version.description: ISO-8601 date of the FAQ content's last substantive update (YYYY-MM-DD).

title.description: Human-readable title for the FAQ document, surfaced on the rendered page hero.

lead.description: One-paragraph introduction shown above the first section. Plain text or limited inline HTML (em, strong, code, a).

sections.description: Ordered list of FAQ sections. The consumer renders them in array order.

id.description: URL-safe slug for the section. Used as the v-expansion-panel value and for deep-linking.

title.description: Section heading rendered as the expansion-panel title.

lead.description: Optional one-line summary shown under the section title before the first item.

items.description: Ordered list of Q&A entries in this section. The consumer renders them in array order.

id.description: URL-safe slug, unique within the document. Used for deep-linking.

answer_html.description: HTML answer body. Limited inline + block markup: p, ul, ol, li, strong, em, code, pre, a, table/thead/tbody/tr/th/td, router-link. The consumer is responsible for sanitisation if rendered into a v-html target.
